method: Original Japanese instructional copy and listening/record-and-compare exercises. Reuse of existing model audio, no new synthesis or external recording.
rules: Articulation contrasts follow the app's previously sourced NIKL pronunciation materials. Do not score modern merged ae/e as distinct. Final stops are unreleased; liaison examples use existing course1-16 model clips with original orthography preserved.
audio: Lessons 1-9 use existing catalogued Supertonic clips, lesson 10 reuses bundled course voice clips for 문을 열어요./물을 마셔요./밥을 먹어요.
recording: User-initiated browser MediaRecorder, up to 8 seconds, temporary Blob URL, no network or persistence, microphone tracks and URL disposed on exit. No automatic pronunciation score.
validation: Automated file/canonical text mapping and browser mocked audio/recording tests. New human listening and physical-device recording are not certified.
